subject.title: Support Azure Foundry GPT Realtime Talk via gateway relay

question: Should OpenClaw support Azure Foundry GPT Realtime Talk in the bundled `openai` provider now, and what constrained Azure endpoint/auth contract should the Gateway Relay own first?
rationale: The remaining work changes provider auth, credential retention, endpoint construction, and redirect behavior, and those security/product choices should be confirmed before implementation.

options.title: Approve constrained API-key relay first
options.body: Use the existing `azureEndpoint` and `azureDeployment` config shape, build the current GA Azure server-side route safely, constrain redirect/host behavior, and defer Entra ID or `azure-openai` alias work.

options.title: Wait for live Azure quota and Entra design
options.body: Keep this open but pause implementation until maintainers can prove a real Azure Realtime deployment and decide the Entra ID contract.

options.title: Decline bundled support
options.body: Close only if maintainers decide Azure Realtime Talk should be provided outside the bundled `openai` provider despite the existing provider-owned Azure config surface.

recommendation.title: Approve constrained API-key relay first
recommendation.body: Use the existing `azureEndpoint` and `azureDeployment` config shape, build the current GA Azure server-side route safely, constrain redirect/host behavior, and defer Entra ID or `azure-openai` alias work.

likelyOwner.reason: This person already performed the Azure live-account check and is the clearest current routing point for the product/security decision.
